title: Attack on Titan — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
The story Attack on Titan tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. Attack on Titan (Japanese: 進撃の巨人, Hepburn: Shingeki no Kyojin; lit. 'The Advancing Giant') is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama. It was serialized in Kodansha's monthly magazine Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine from September 2009 to April 2021, with its chapters collected in 34 tankōbon volumes.

Strip Attack on Titan of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. Before serialization began in 2009, he had already thought of ideas for plot twists, although they were fleshed out as the series progressed. Isayama initially based the scenery in the manga on that of his hometown of Hita, Ōita, which is surrounded by mountains.
